title: calibrachoa heterophylla
intro: Calibrachoa heterophylla, commonly known as Mini Petunia, is a flowering plant species native to Brazil. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties that may aid in wound healing and the management of infections. The therapeutic actions of Calibrachoa heterophylla are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
